title: PersistedProjectEnvelope
description: The whole project file: what it is, which schema it speaks, who wrote it, whether it is intact, and the project itself. The envelope exists so that an opening build can answer 'may I read this' before it tries to (401 sections 3 and 10).

format.description: Identifies the file as a Mirae project. 401 invariant 1: a format identifies itself rather than relying on its extension.

schemaVersion.description: The project schema major version. Explicit, because a file that does not say what it is cannot be migrated (401 invariant 2).

projectId.description: Stable project identifier, as a canonical hyphenated UUID. Survives renames, moves, and copies (401 invariant 3).

createdAt.description: When the project was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

lastSavedAt.description: When this file was written, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

app.description: Which Mirae versions wrote this file and which one it needs.

features.description: Features this project requires. An unsupported entry is refused or opened read-only, never ignored (401 invariant 7).
